post.description:
Duplicate the current version as an independent document in the same or another folder.

The copy gets its own Core file, its own resource and its own grants, so editing
it never touches the original's versions; the original keeps a reference to what
was duplicated.

FileCopy.title: FileCopy
FileCopy.description:
Duplicate a document the caller can already read.

No revision is taken on the source: copying changes nothing about it. An
Idempotency-Key is required instead, because a retried copy would otherwise create a
second independent document.
